INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Artificial Intelligence, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence.

2. When learning Emerging Trends in ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Trends in ICT.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.

3. When learning Audial- Visual Creation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audial- Visual Creation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Audial- Visual Creation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audial- Visual Creation.

4. When learning Graphic Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Graphic Design.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Graphic Design.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Graphic Design.

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

9. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.

10. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Graphic Design and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Audial- Visual Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Emerging Trends in ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.

2. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.

3. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.

4. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.

5. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands

6. B — CPU

7. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

8. A — Information and Communication Technology

9. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.

10. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.

11. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Graphic Design; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

12. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Audial- Visual Creation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Digital Citizenship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Emerging Trends in ICT; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
